title: Cross coming: attack the back post
titleKid: Cross coming: run to the far post
brief: You are holding the width on the far side as your other winger beats their full-back.
briefKid: You are on the far side. Your other winger beats their defender.
question: Your winger is about to cross. Where do you go?
questionKid: A cross is coming from the other side. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: Once the ball is wide near their byline, the far winger's job changes: leave the touchline and attack the back post, onside, so the cross has a target in every scoring zone.
takeaway.kid: Cross coming from the other side? Run into the box to the far post.

misconceptions.text: You stayed out on the touchline, but the cross is coming from the other wing, so nobody is attacking the back post.
misconceptions.textKid: You stayed wide. The cross is coming, so run into the box.

misconceptions.text: You ran in beyond their last defender, so if the cross comes now you are offside; arrive level with their line and attack the ball from there.
misconceptions.textKid: Too far in! Stay level with their last defender until the cross.
